title: gVisor: Core types, OCI spec builder, cgroup translator
description:
Implement gVisor manager foundation from docs/plans/10-sandbox-gvisor.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (types + constants), §4.1 (GVisorManager interface), §4.2 (OCI spec builder), §4.3 (cgroup v2 translator)

Key deliverables:
- GVisorManager interface in internal/sandbox/gvisor/gvisor.go
- Core types: ContainerOptions, ContainerResult, ContainerStatus (StatusExited/StatusTimedOut/StatusKilled/StatusOOMKilled), ResourceLimits
- OCI runtime spec builder: builds OCI-compliant config.json from ContainerOptions (rootfs, mounts, env, args, resource limits, namespaces)
- Cgroup v2 translator: converts ResourceLimits to cgroup v2 filesystem entries (cpu.max, memory.max, memory.swap.max, pids.max)
- Constants: default timeout, default memory limit, max container name length
- Unit tests for all types, spec builder (verify OCI compliance), cgroup translator

See Implementation Guide §1.12: Each Run() creates a fresh container. OOM detection only when Status==StatusExited && ExitCode==137. Close() returns ErrManagerClosed on subsequent Run() calls.
